title: Inverdoorn Exclusive Day Safari
description: Escape the crowds on a reserve dedicated to conservation and intimate wildlife encounters.
existing_faqs: Q:How far is the reserve? A:2.5 h scenic drive.||Q:Is there a minimum age? A:Children 4+ welcome.

title: Cape Town Tandem Skydive
description: Jump from 10 000 ft with some of SA’s most experienced skydivers and capture every scream on camera.
existing_faqs: Q:Weight limit? A:Max 100 kg; extra 90–100 kg surcharge.||Q:Can glasses be worn? A:Goggles fit over specs.

title: Simon's Town
description: Uncover 200 years of maritime history, meet the famous Just Nuisance dog statue and browse quirky harbour shops in Cape Town's oldest naval base town.
existing_faqs: Q:Is the naval museum included? A:Yes, free entry is guided.||Q:Can we add a penguin visit? A:Combine with Boulders stop on request.

title: Chapman's Peak Drive
description: Hug sandstone cliffs high above the Atlantic, thrill at hair‑pin bends and capture postcard‑worthy panoramas every kilometre.
existing_faqs: Q:Is the road safe? A:Yes, regularly inspected & speed limited.||Q:Can we stop for drone shots? A:Drone use needs a permit; ask beforehand.

title: Maiden's Cove
description: Discover Cape Town’s postcard viewpoint—granite boulders, crystal pools and sweeping vistas over Camps Bay.
existing_faqs: Q:Is swimming supervised? A:No lifeguards—swim at own risk.||Q:Will we see dolphins? A:Occasional sightings May–Aug.

title: Table Mountain Cableway
description: Ascend 1 000 m in the rotating cableway and witness mind‑blowing city and ocean vistas from the natural wonder of Table Mountain.
existing_faqs: Q:What if the cableway closes? A:Full refund or alternative tour.||Q:Is hiking down an option? A:Yes, guide can arrange pick‑up.

title: Babylonstoren Wine Estate
description: Stroll storybook gardens, peek inside the gravity‑fed cellar and savour estate‑grown wines paired with artisanal cheese.
existing_faqs: Q:Is tasting included? A:Yes, five wines.||Q:Non‑alcoholic option? A:Garden herbal tea flight available.

title: Aquila Big 5 Day Safari
description: Swap the city for roaring lions and towering elephants on Cape Town’s closest Big 5 adventure.
existing_faqs: Q:Is this tour suitable for kids? A:Yes, 3+; half price under 11.||Q:What animals can we see? A:Big 5 plus giraffe, hippo & more.

title: Signal Hill Tandem Paragliding
description: Launch from Signal Hill or Lion’s Head and glide over Camps Bay, landing on the soft sand near the ocean.
existing_faqs: Q:Can we choose flight time? A:We confirm best wind slot on booking day.||Q:Is it scary? A:Take‑off is a gentle run; pilots control everything.

title: Muizenberg Beach
description: Ride Cape Town’s warm‑water break, snap the iconic pastel bathing boxes and hear shark‑spotter stories from your local guide.
existing_faqs: Q:Is swimming safe? A:Yes, lifeguards & shark spotters on duty.||Q:Do we need to bring towels? A:Lightweight travel towels available on request.

title: Cape Point Lighthouse
description: Ascend to the 1859 lighthouse by cliff‑hugging railway or scenic trail and gaze across the Atlantic meeting the Indian Ocean.
existing_faqs: Q:Is hiking necessary? A:No, funicular gives easy access.||Q:Are there restrooms? A:Yes, at upper station.

title: Camps Bay Beach
description: Bask on fine white sand under the Twelve Apostles, then join the promenade buzz of cafés and cocktail bars.
existing_faqs: Q:Is alcohol allowed on beach? A:No, but bars are metres away.||Q:Are showers available? A:Yes, public facilities nearby.

title: Boschendal Wine Estate
description: Sip award‑winning vintages where French Huguenots first planted vines in 1685 and savour a farm‑box picnic on lush lawns.
existing_faqs: Q:Vegetarian picnic available? A:Yes, advise dietary needs.||Q:Kids menu? A:Child picnic basket offered.

title: Atlantis Dunes Sandboard & ATV
description: Carve 50‑m dunes by board then rev an ATV across the Atlantis wilderness – eco‑permits sorted.
existing_faqs: Q:Do I need experience? A:No, full tutorial given.||Q:Weight limit? A:120 kg for boards, 100 kg for quads.

title: Winelands Sunrise Balloon Flight
description: A bucket‑list dawn lift‑off revealing the Cape Winelands in golden light, followed by gourmet farm breakfast.
existing_faqs: Q:How high do we fly? A:300‑900 m above ground.||Q:What if weather cancels? A:Full refund or reschedule.

title: Cape of Good Hope
description: Trek windswept headlands, snap the iconic signpost and watch for ostrich and baboons on Africa’s southwestern tip.
existing_faqs: Q:How much walking is involved? A:≈1 km; hike optional.||Q:Are bathrooms available? A:Yes, at visitor centre.

title: V&A Waterfront
description: From the 1860 Clock Tower to modern mega‑yachts, experience the evolution of Cape Town’s working waterfront with insider commentary and shopping tips.
existing_faqs: Q:How much free time is included? A:≈1 h for shopping/eating.||Q:Can we stay longer? A:Yes, arrange drop‑off time with guide.

title: Sea Point Promenade
description: Soak up Atlantic breezes, jogger energy and urban art on the city’s favourite 7‑km seaside boardwalk.
existing_faqs: Q:How far is the walk? A:≈3 km easy stroll.||Q:Can we bike instead? A:Bike rental can be arranged.

title: Delaire Graff Estate
description: Experience the pinnacle of Cape hospitality—ultra‑premium wines, world‑class sculpture garden and dazzling valley views.
existing_faqs: Q:Is dress code smart casual? A:Yes, no beachwear.||Q:Can we buy diamonds? A:Yes, Graff jewellery boutique on site.

title: Hermanus Whale Watching Cruise
description: Experience the world capital of land & boat‑based whale watching with added local flavours.
existing_faqs: Q:When is peak whale season? A:Sep & Oct for mating & calving.||Q:Are life jackets provided? A:Yes, mandatory on boat.

title: Gansbaai Shark Cage Diving
description: Dive into the world of sharks on South Africa’s leading conservation‑focused operator.
existing_faqs: Q:Do I need scuba cert? A:No, breath‑hold surface cage.||Q:Water temp? A:13–17 °C; wetsuit provided.

title: Boulders Beach Penguin Colony
description: Stand metres from tuxedo‑clad African penguins as your guide shares quirky behaviour insights and expert photo tricks.
existing_faqs: Q:Can we swim with penguins? A:Possible at adjacent public beach (tide‑dependent).||Q:Is it wheelchair accessible? A:Boardwalk is ramp‑friendly; sand is not.

title: Hout Bay Harbour
description: Dive into local harbour life, sample fresh fish‑and‑chips and photograph Cape fur seals lounging on the docks.
existing_faqs: Q:Is the boat trip guaranteed? A:Weather permitting; refund on site if cancelled.||Q:Do market stalls take cards? A:Most do, but carry some cash.

title: Bo-Kaap Heritage Quarter
description: Explore rainbow‑painted façades, call‑to‑prayer echoes and spice‑laden aromas in Cape Town’s most photogenic neighbourhood.
existing_faqs: Q:Are photos of residents okay? A:Ask permission; guide assists.||Q:Is mosque entry compulsory? A:No, exterior only unless you wish to enter respectfully.

title: Tokara Wine Estate
description: Elevate your palate with comparative tastings of cool‑climate wines and premium extra‑virgin olive oil amid architect‑designed surrounds.
existing_faqs: Q:Can we add lunch? A:Yes, reserve at Tokara Restaurant.||Q:Is there a chocolate pairing? A:Seasonal artisan pairing available.
